reference_sql:
SELECT cal_date,
       CASE WHEN weekday_name IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type
FROM calendar
WHERE cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
alternatives: SELECT cal_date, CASE WHEN is_weekend THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type FROM calendar WHERE cal_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND cal_date <= DATE '2025-04-30'
SELECT cal_date, CASE WHEN weekday_name = 'Saturday' OR weekday_name = 'Sunday' THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS day_type FROM calendar WHERE cal_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'
